desc: Lightweight, 6 piece field to freezer game processing set complete with a full-tang capping knife, gut-hook skinner, Boning knife, two-stage fine ceramic/coarse carbide sharpener, game cleaning gloves and hard-side carry case. Blades are hand finished Shaving sharp to ensure superior edge retention and performance. Non-slip rubberized blaze Orange handles never get Lost and feature an embossed Elk horn design for enhanced grip.
